name: links-and-notes
description: My Favorite Links and My Notes in one Windows app

scripts.build: node build.js && electron-packager . LinksAndNotes --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=icon.ico --ignore="(^/dist|^/shell|^/build\.js|^/icon\.png)" --win32metadata.ProductName="Links & Notes" --win32metadata.FileDescription="Links & Notes"
